assumptions: Source scope: single-trip fuel cost over that trip's distance; the brief-19-deferred physical-measure sibling of economics--money-unit-rate@r1 (counts-only counted_unit_quantity input), with own input/output meanings and unit -- gallons and miles are physical measures and must not enter counted_unit_quantity.

Application profile: AAA Your Driving Costs 2026 scope reference (fuel budgeted in cents per mile on a $4.152/gal regular-grade 12-month average ending May 2026, within a 5-year/75,000-mile study); oracles below are EIA/EPA cross-arithmetic, not AAA figures.

gaps: New quantity meanings trip_fuel_cost, trip_distance, driving_fuel_cost_per_distance: absent from the registry vocabulary and from all 262 admitted models' ports (verified 2026-11-04, mode=ro).
New unit USD/mi for the output port (currency-length^-1; scale 1/METERS_PER_MILE).
Per-record context binds no existing chain: no admitted record uses these meanings, so the record forms zero legs.

models.inverse_notes: C = c * D needs no exclusion beyond the original guards; D = C / c requires c > 0. Substitution: c = 0.12978125, D = 320 gives C = 41.53, and forward 41.53 / 320 = 0.12978125. c = 0 with C = 0 leaves D underdetermined (any distance is free); c = 0 with C > 0 is incompatible.
limitations: Excludes non-fuel per-mile costs (maintenance, tires, depreciation, insurance, finance) that AAA bundles into all-in cost per mile.
A zero-distance trip has no per-distance cost (D = 0 domain case); idling cost needs a time-based record.

references.method: EIA/EPA cross-arithmetic: $41.53 (10 gal x $4.153, week ending 11/02/26) / 320 mi (32-mpg rating x 10 gal) = 0.12978125 ($0.1298/mi at 4dp). Tolerance is float hygiene only.
references.provenance: Cross-family worked arithmetic from the EIA price week and the EPA rating above; not an observed trip and not an AAA figure.

rejection_cases.reason: D = 0 violates D > 0: a zero-distance trip has no per-distance cost.
